fixes.what: the sign is placed frame-first (compose.place) whole over the row and held in its box; staging.edges fails any cut words

named.said: BROKEN: the PURE HONEY 2 EUROS sign is cut by the left frame edge in all 4 frames and reads 'NEY 2 EUROS'. The price that sets up the hook is never whole.

fixes.what: the row is framed whole and front-on, the fake jar spins to a big red SYRUP label in the open; his slam makes the whole row jump first

named.said: CONSEQUENCE: the one fake jar is far down the row and half hidden behind the jar next to it. Only a tiny red 'RUP' shows (frames 3-4), so the SYRUP flip is too small to read on a phone. The slam that causes it never reads as a slam (frames 1-2: the dipper is just held at his chest).

fixes.what: seven jars in one counted row, all inside the frame (compose box held), one turns red

named.said: NOT SHOWN: 'one in seven' cannot be counted. The row recedes and overlaps, so you cannot see seven jars with one of them red. Nothing shows that the real share was worse.

fixes.what: cobbled square, produce crates, striped awnings, built house fronts; the stray ball removed

named.said: NOT THE WORLD: the market square is a flat grey concrete floor with a stray pale ball on it. There are no cobbles, no crates of produce, and the back stalls are a row of identical blue figures in front of a strip of cardboard house fronts. It does not match the approved store's finish.

fixes.what: built stall: wood counter, crates of produce, awnings, cobbles, no unexplained objects

named.said: OFF THE LOOK (backgrounds as real as we can make them / approved store is the standard of finish): the square is a flat grey speckled floor, boxy flat-front buildings, plain counter planks, and an unexplained white egg-shaped object on the ground beside the counter (all frames). It is nowhere near the built, lived-in finish of approved_hook_store.jpg.

fixes.what: rebuilt: the HONEY flag hangs on a rope up its pole, hauled by a winch he cranks

named.said: BROKEN: the 'flags' are cards floating in mid-air beside the poles, not attached to them. There are no halyards and no flags. The HONEY card sits at different heights with nothing holding it (frames 1-4).

fixes.what: the board's numbers sit between the poles in clear view; the HONEY flag climbs four bands to the syrup flag's one

named.said: NOT SHOWN: the price board's ticks (0.50 to 2.00) are unreadable on a phone and Data hides them. 'A quarter as much' shows only as the numbers 0.50 and 2.17 on placards, not as a height you can read as four times.

fixes.what: window is a real framed window with jars on a sill behind glass; the hanging slab removed; void doorway removed

named.said: NOT THE WORLD: the yard is a stage set. The 'sunny window full of jars' is a flat white panel with jars printed on it, the doorway is a black void, and a dark green slab with white lines hangs across the top of the frame (frames 1-4).

fixes.what: he cranks the winch and the flag climbs because of it (staging.cause checks hand on the cause before motion)

named.said: OFF THE LOOK (Data CAUSES what moves): there are no flags and no ropes. In all frames Data stands between the poles with his hands at his chest or spread, while the HONEY placard rises on its own (frames 2-4).

fixes.what: he works the winch side-on most of the shot; staging.talking now fails a centred idle head

named.said: TALKING HEAD: Data is centred, facing the lens, chest-up and doing little across all 4 frames.

fixes.what: FAIL lamp and screen light red on test 1 and 2, PASS green on test 3; dip and touch to the box are on the board's stills

named.said: CONSEQUENCE: the red FAIL lamp is never seen. The TEST box screen is black in frames 1-3, so the try, fail, tune, pass sequence collapses to one green PASS (frame 4). The dip into the vat and the touch to the box are never shown either.

fixes.what: the gauge is a tall HONEY/SYRUP column on the vat front, held in frame by a compose box

named.said: NOT SHOWN: the gauge that should read 'mostly syrup' while it passes is a thin strip on the left cylinder and unreadable. 'Tuned to pass while still fake' is lost.

fixes.what: sacks are stencilled SYRUP sacks with necks and ties; the window has dusty lit glass

named.said: NOT THE WORLD: the 'dusty window' is a flat white grid panel. The 'sacks of SYRUP' are smooth beige balls that read as stones, not sacks (frames 1-4).

fixes.what: sacks with necks, ties and stencils; window glass lit by the sun

named.said: OFF THE LOOK (real parts): the SYRUP sacks are plain cream spheres, and the dusty window is a white grid panel with no glass and no light through it.

fixes.what: retimed to the stills: dipping / red FAIL / cranking still red / green PASS; staging.keys now fails identical stills

named.said: ONE-SECOND GAG: frames 1-3 are near-identical: the same pose, hand at the wheel, box dark. Nothing new happens until frame 4.

fixes.what: lower lens framed first on his face (frame_data); the hat check now counts only his body

named.said: TINY DATA / face hidden: the high lens plus the hat brim cover Data's eyes in frames 1-3.

fixes.what: framed first with a wider lens so he ends the beat whole; staging.edges fails any of him off frame at the end

named.said: BROKEN: in frame 4, the end of the shot, Data is cut in half by the right frame edge, so his reaction is lost.

fixes.what: he pours the jar into the machine's funnel and the needle swings after it (staging.cause)

named.said: OFF THE LOOK (Data CAUSES what moves): there is no funnel and no drop. The jar sits on a wooden post while Data stands beside it with an arm out (frames 1-2). The machine swings to FAKE with no visible cause.

fixes.what: camera framed first with him whole; the rack is boxed whole in frame; brim and ears fixed in the shared hat

named.said: BROKEN: in frame 3 the hat swallows Data's whole face. The plank and jar row is cut by the right frame edge in frames 1-2. Data's ears poke through the hat crown in every frame.

fixes.what: the scanner bar sweeps the whole rack and three of every seven jars are red; he ends pointing at you: what's in your jar

named.said: NO PAYOFF: the last frame is Data standing and holding a jar out. It's a pose, not a visual payoff of the near-half count.

fixes.what: a full rack of three tiers of seven jars, three in seven red per tier, readable at once

named.said: NOT SHOWN: 'almost half' and 'three times one in seven' are not seen. There is one short row of 6-8 jars, and the SUSPECT labels show 1-3 at a time. The 'whole stock in long rows' is absent, so no count or proportion reads.

fixes.what: real cobble texture in the alley; the stray ball removed; brick walls, crates

named.said: NOT THE WORLD: the 'cobbled alley' floor reads as grey polka-dot fabric, not cobbles (all frames). An unexplained grey ball labelled 'SUC…' sits on the ground in frame 4.

fixes.what: cobbles, a steel rack on the ground, no tilting plank

named.said: OFF THE LOOK (real textures): the alley floor is a grey polka-dot pattern, not cobbles. The plank rests on loose crates and tilts (frame 4).

fixes.what: face held toward the lens during the beat, frame_data on his face, hat brim smaller

named.said: TINY DATA / BACK-ish: Data's face is hidden under the hat brim in frames 2-3 (head bowed), and in frame 3 the hat fills the frame centre.
